items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: So that's the time I came in with Moe Gale.

ctx.x: So I said, 'Well, I ain't going to give up no part of my band.' And it squares me out. So that's the time I came in with Moe Gale.
Oh. Well, Cootie who were you dealing with there?
